argv:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$HOME/.local/share/bridge-comand-bootstrap"
test -d "$ROOT/.git" || git clone https://github.com/One-Wave-Universe/Bridge-Comand.git "$ROOT"
git -C "$ROOT" fetch --prune origin main
git -C "$ROOT" checkout --detach origin/main
export ONE_WAVE_PROJECT_ROOT=/home/Scales/One-Wave-Science
bash "$ROOT/hive-pipe/bootstrap_chatgpt_terminal_pull.sh"
systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user enable --now hive-pipe-agent.service hive-pipe-gateway.service one-wave-chatgpt-terminal-pull.service one-wave-bridge-lattice-watchdog.timer one-wave-route-goblin.timer
python3 "$ROOT/hive-pipe/route_goblin.py"
python3 "$ROOT/hive-pipe/bridge_lattice_watchdog.py" || true
printf 'CONTROL_PLANE_RECEIPT\n'
for s in hive-pipe-agent.service hive-pipe-gateway.service one-wave-chatgpt-terminal-pull.service one-wave-bridge-lattice-watchdog.timer one-wave-route-goblin.timer; do printf '%s=' "$s"; systemctl --user is-active "$s"; done
printf 'BRIDGE_COMMIT='; git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse HEAD
intention: Bring the complete Jetson-native control plane operational without Desktop Commander and verify every required service.
consequence: Updates Bridge-Comand runtime, enables/starts Hive Pipe agent and gateway, GitHub pull listener, watchdog and Route Goblin, then emits explicit receipts.
